visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Missing Parentheses Around p + i
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The elements 5, 10, 15 and 20 add up to 50, but the program prints sum = 26.

solution.explanation: The * operator binds tighter than +, so *p + i reads the first element and adds i to the value. The parentheses in *(p + i) move the address first and then read that element.
